_comment: Retail prices for the frozen shelf, read only by `kitchen:price-frozen-shelf`. The v6 workbook leaves every frozen row unpriced, so the import publishes them without a price or a channel and the marketplace hides them. These are PLACEHOLDER figures set on 2026-10-07 to put the shelf on sale, roughly 2.5x the simulated purchase cost in simulation-prices.json; replace them with the kitchen's own tariff. Each is the price of one piece, the `unit` pack the importer gives an unpriced row, in USD minor units.
